newsitem.title: UK: Westminster Health Care in 22.6 mln stg buy.
newsitem.headline: Westminster Health Care in 22.6 mln stg buy.

text.p: Westminster Health Care (WHC), the UK nursing home and health care group, said on Wednesday it had bought a PPP healthcare nursing home and assisted living division for 22.6 million stg
As part of the deal, WHC and PPP Healthcare Group have formed a business relationship to develop and provide a range of health care products and services for the elderly, WHC said in a statement.
Under the deal, WHC will become the main preferred provider of long-term care for PPP Healthcare's customers.
WHC said it would pay for the acquisition from existing bank facilities, adding that the acquistion would be earnings neutral in 1997/98.

The nursing home and assisted living division, which is based mainly in south east England, is called PPP Beaumont Plc. It has net assets of around 22.4 million stg and operates nine nursing centres with a further two under construction.
With its 510 registered beds with 148 assisted living apartments on five nursing centre sites, the business generated a pre-tax profit of 160,000 stg on turnover of 8.3 million stg last year.
